title: Facility maintenance request
goal: A practitioner can read this event-driven process chain at a glance: Facility maintenance request.

rubric.must: The named scenario is visibly identified and its primary subject is clearly shown.

review.evidence: The title clearly names “Facility maintenance request.” Events are shown as purple hexagons, functions as green rounded rectangles, and the XOR connectors as circles with × marks. The flow is traceable from fault reported through work-order closure; the parts-needed and repairable-on-site branches visibly rejoin before repair. Labels are legible, and no material overlap or unintended connection is apparent.
